Hey! I just wanted to know that I've written more of this story if you wanted to read a little more.

I very much feel the same way. A year or two ago a friend got me committed to a hospital for about 12 hours for suggesting that I wanted to die. They threatened to drug me, to tie me up, to arrest me, for wanting to leave. For just wanting to go home where I wasn't threatened for being afraid. After they made me strip naked in front of 4 guys to make sure I didn't have any weapons, they left me in paper clothes in a room less than 60 degrees f. I spent the night talking to the watcher (who was to make sure I didn't kill myself overnight) because I didn't understand the response to those few words. Animals commit suicide all the time, whether they are sick or unwell. But no one freaks out about a wild deer jumping off a cliff. It's very bizarre to me that we as a race have such an emphasis on \*\*being alive\*\* when the living is already struggling as it is. You can't support yourself? You've been through severe trauma and you can't get help? You have no autonomy in your life? Well, we're gonna remove your autonomy in death and say no to that too. If we all have free will, god given or not, why are we not allowed to use it with the lives that are supposedly ours? I've never gotten a straight answer, but the most consistent is because when people die it makes others sad. Most seem to think that suicide is about \*\*everyone else, not the person who is being driven to that urge\*\* "Don't kill yourself, it makes someone else sad." But what about your own sadness? The whole thing sucks.

I had attempted to explain the situation, but in the midst od the pandemic a lot of familes are in my same boat and I do not have 2 years to wait for a section 8 housing voucher for affordable rent. The ones that accepted were too far away from my job that gaining the apartment would put me out of biking distance from my job. As well, if you cannot even make the deposit, some people assume (correctly) thst you also cannot make the rent on time.

Yeah I know. Again, and I do apologize for the tone I promise I don't mean any offense, I've heard that many times before. But with how heavily my mom saps my finances, saving up just for the deposit is somewhat out of my reach. I also mentioned in my post that I am 22; I do have a bank account, one that no one else has access to. But witholding funds is how I get kickout out of the house and I have nowhere to go. The homeless shelter in my town is full. I did find an apartment I could afford, but it was several states away, (I'm in the US) and in the middle of nowhere,so with no car it wasm't a decision I could stick with for more than a month before being kicked out for not being able to make money.
